tools.name: celgrid_guide
tools.description: Read the Celgrid prompt recipe, quality and animation controls, and engine export guide.

tools.name: celgrid_library
tools.description: Browse the free starter packs or list your saved assets and IDs.

tools.name: celgrid_create_blank
tools.description: Create a clean transparent blank pixel canvas (4x4 to 64x64, 1 to 16 frames) at 0 credits.

tools.name: celgrid_generate
tools.description: Generate a sprite or animate a saved pose. Read celgrid_guide first. Claude calls incur API usage.

tools.name: celgrid_revise
tools.description: Repair one exposure or draw and insert its next pose. Frame numbers start at 1. The original remains in the library.

tools.name: celgrid_propagate_edit
tools.description: AI Ripple Edit: propagate a manual edit from one frame across remaining frames and up to 6 linked animations.

tools.name: celgrid_edit_pixels
tools.description: Save direct indexed pixel edits for one frame without API cost. Creates a new immutable version.

tools.name: celgrid_rename
tools.description: Set a short display title on a saved asset.

tools.name: celgrid_timing
tools.description: Save a new playback and export rate for an existing animation, without redrawing.

tools.name: celgrid_export
tools.description: Get the local frame preview, validated sheet layout and engine download links.
